Replace with the real lineup. `id` is the URL slug (/films/<id>). `event` is sfc | uts | edu | main. `poster` and `trailer` are media keys in media.json (trailer can be null). `date` is YYYY-MM-DD, `time` is free text.

items.title: Garam dan Gula
items.synopsis: Two sisters inherit their grandmother's roadside warung and must decide whether to keep the family recipe or sell the land to a developer.

items.title: Ombak Terakhir
items.synopsis: A young surfer in Bali spends one last morning in the water before leaving the island for university abroad.
items.language: Indonesian and Balinese with English subtitles

items.title: Surat untuk Ibu
items.synopsis: An Indonesian student in Melbourne records voice notes to her mother that she never sends.
items.language: Indonesian and English with English subtitles

items.title: Tukang Cukur
items.synopsis: Under a banyan tree in Yogyakarta, an old barber hears the whole neighbourhood's secrets, one haircut at a time.

items.title: Benang Merah
items.synopsis: A hand-drawn animation following a single red thread through three generations of batik makers.

items.title: Rumah di Ujung Jalan
items.englishTitle: The House at the End of the Road
items.synopsis: When a family returns to their ancestral home in West Sumatra for a funeral, old rivalries surface between siblings who haven't spoken in years.
items.language: Indonesian and Minang with English subtitles

items.title: Senandika
items.synopsis: A celebrated stage actor in Jakarta begins losing his memory and rehearses his final role as if it were his own life.

items.title: Musim Kemarau
items.synopsis: In a village in East Nusa Tenggara waiting for rain, a schoolteacher organises the children to dig a well.

items.title: Pasar Malam
items.synopsis: Over one chaotic night at a travelling market, a ferris-wheel operator, a runaway and a fortune teller cross paths.

items.title: Kabut di Dieng
items.synopsis: A folk-horror tale set on the Dieng Plateau, where a documentary crew films a ritual they were told never to record.
items.language: Indonesian and Javanese with English subtitles
